transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well, doctor, lately I keep jumping into big plans and trips without thinking, and it’s starting to cause some real problems for my family. They actually insisted I come in to see you because they've gotten so worried about me.
Have you ever experienced a period in the past where you felt persistently low, hopeless, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

No, I haven't really ever experienced periods of feeling persistently low or losing interest in things. I'm usually a pretty warm, steady person who loves being involved in my community. It's really just this recent high-energy phase and all these big plans that have been the main issue for me.
During these high-energy periods, have you ever experienced any unusual beliefs that others might find strange, or heard or seen things that others could not?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't hear or see things that aren't there, and my beliefs are normal. It's just that my mind is racing with too many ideas and plans for real-world projects.
How many days have you been feeling this way, and would you say this high-energy state is significant enough to interfere with your ability to work or maintain your daily responsibilities?

This has been going on for about a month now, starting right when my supervisor pushed me to set a firm retirement date. It's definitely interfering with my life—I've missed mentoring commitments, upset my church leaders with impulsive plans, and scared my family by disappearing on long solo drives. My wife says she just can't rely on me or feel safe about what I'll do next.
Have you ever had a similar period of high energy and impulsive behavior in the past, even if it was less intense or didn't cause as many problems as this time?

No, I have never experienced anything like this before in my life. My family and friends have always known me to have a very warm, steady presence, and this past month is really the first time I've ever felt this level of overwhelming energy and impulsivity.
Have you ever felt that you had special powers, a secret mission, or that you were receiving messages from the television, radio, or people around you during this time?

No, I've never felt like I had special powers or any kind of secret mission, and I certainly don't get messages from the TV or radio. While I do have a ton of energy and all these big plans right now, I don't experience anything like that.
Have you recently started any new medications, supplements, or experienced any new physical health issues, such as changes in your sleep, headaches, or recent medical tests?

I've definitely had changes in my sleep, waking up after just a few hours buzzing with energy and physically unable to sit still. My back has also been hurting from overexerting myself with all these projects, but I haven't started any new medications or supplements, and I haven't had headaches or recent medical tests.
Have you noticed any other physical symptoms recently, such as changes in your vision, coordination, memory, or any unexplained changes in your general health?

No, I haven't noticed any changes in my vision, coordination, or memory, and my general physical health feels fine. The only thing is that my back is a bit sore from all the constant activity and pacing around.

Have you noticed any recent changes in your personality, speech, or ability to perform familiar tasks that your family might have commented on, or have you had any recent head injuries or neurological check-ups?

Yes, my family and pastor have definitely noticed I’m talking incredibly fast, jumping from topic to topic, and snapping at them over the smallest things. I also can't sit still, get easily distracted from simple tasks, and have missed commitments, which makes my wife feel like she can't rely on me. I haven't had any head injuries or recent neurological check-ups, though.
Have you noticed any recent changes in your appetite, significant weight loss or gain, or any unusual physical sensations like tremors or muscle twitching?
No, I haven't really noticed any changes in my appetite or weight. I also haven't experienced any tremors or muscle twitching.
Have you had any recent blood work, a physical examination, or an MRI/CT scan of your brain performed by your primary care doctor to rule out any underlying medical conditions?

My primary care doctor did a quick physical evaluation and referred me urgently to psychiatry, but I haven't had any brain scans or specific blood work done yet. I'm not really sure if they planned on ordering those tests or not.
Have you experienced any recent changes in your sense of smell, personality, or any unexplained episodes of confusion or disorientation that your family might have noticed?

I haven't noticed any changes in my sense of smell, and I haven't felt confused or disoriented at all. However, my family has definitely pointed out how much my behavior and mood have changed lately with all this high energy.
Have you noticed any recent changes in your bowel or bladder habits, or have you experienced any unexplained seizures or periods where you blanked out?
No, I haven't noticed any changes in my bowel or bladder habits at all. I also haven't had any seizures or times where I've blanked out. Everything like that has been completely normal.
Have you noticed any recent changes in your gait, balance, or fine motor skills, such as difficulty with buttoning shirts or handwriting?
No, I haven't noticed any changes in my gait, balance, or fine motor skills. My hands and balance seem to be working completely fine.
Have you experienced any recent unexplained changes in your personality or behavior that coincide with any new physical symptoms, such as sudden weakness, numbness, or persistent headaches?

No, I haven't experienced any sudden weakness, numbness, or persistent headaches at all. I really haven't noticed any physical symptoms like that. It's just the high energy and restlessness that I've been dealing with.
Given that this is your first episode of such behavior, could you tell me how old you are?

I am 74 years old. Experiencing these kinds of intense changes at this point in my life, especially as I've been trying to transition into retirement, has been quite surprising for me and very alarming for my family.
Have you noticed any changes in your thirst, the amount of urine you produce, or have you had any recent unexplained fevers or infections?
No, I haven't noticed any changes in my thirst or how much I'm urinating. I also haven't had any recent fevers or infections.
Have you experienced any changes in your cognitive function, such as difficulty finding words, forgetting recent conversations, or problems with complex decision-making?

I don't have any trouble finding words or forgetting conversations, but my mind is constantly distracted and jumping from one thing to another, which stops me from actually finishing what I start. My decision-making has also been highly impulsive and problematic, leading to risky commitments and financial choices that I only regret afterward.
Have you ever been diagnosed with any chronic medical conditions like high blood pressure, diabetes, or thyroid issues, or have you recently had any unexplained weight loss or night sweats?

No, I don't have any of those chronic conditions like high blood pressure, diabetes, or thyroid issues, and I haven't had any unexplained weight loss or night sweats. I really only have some general back pain from running around so much lately, but nothing like what you're asking about.
Have you noticed any subtle changes in your personality, such as becoming more impulsive, socially disinhibited, or less empathetic compared to how you were even a few months ago?

Yes, my personality has shifted completely over the past month from my usual warm, steady self. I've become incredibly impulsive, making rash promises, taking off on long drives without telling anyone, and showing up unannounced to push my ideas on church leadership. I also find myself snapping at my wife and pastor over minor pushback, and I struggle to show my usual empathy or dial it back even when I see how much it upsets them.
Have you noticed any changes in your sense of taste, or have you experienced any episodes where you felt unusually clumsy or had sudden, unexplained drops in your blood sugar levels?
No, I haven't noticed any changes in my sense of taste, and I haven't been feeling clumsy at all. I also haven't had any issues or sudden drops in my blood sugar levels.
Have you or your family noticed any recent changes in your ability to follow social cues, such as making inappropriate comments in public or failing to recognize when others are uncomfortable?

It's not so much that I don't notice people are uncomfortable, but rather that I just can't seem to stop myself. I've been showing up unannounced to push my ideas, snapping at my wife and pastor, and talking over everyone so fast they can't get a word in. Even when I can see that I'm upsetting or overwhelming them, I feel physically unable to dial it back.

Have you or your family noticed any recent, subtle changes in your executive functioning, such as difficulty planning or organizing tasks, or any new repetitive behaviors or fixations that were not present before this month?

Yes, planning and organizing have become incredibly difficult because my mind constantly gets distracted by every little thing—like trying to plan a simple church cookout but getting sidetracked by a bird outside or the TV and never finishing. I've also been constantly pacing, rearranging my workshop, and obsessively making endless lists of projects. My wife has really noticed this and keeps begging me to just sit down and rest, but I feel physically unable to do so.
